benchmark_name: Sunborn Cache In-Memory Engine L1 Throughput

workload.description: In-process exact-match cache get/insert on the L1 memory tier. No network, no serialization, no gateway routing.

notes: Single-machine measurement. Re-run the command above to reproduce on your own hardware; the number is a property of the machine and the release profile, not a constant.
This is an in-process cache tier benchmark. It is NOT an end-to-end gateway figure and NOT a network round trip. For the served-request numbers, see benchmarks/production_soak_results.json.
The previously published figure of 993,961.7 req/s / P50 0.900 us / P99 1.500 us had no recorded run behind it and has been replaced by this measurement.
